name: 5 · KG Persist / Finalize
description: Step 5 of the discrete import-artifacts pipeline. Recompute cross-source corroboration, backfill canonical KG embeddings when missing, and refresh the kg.nt graph snapshot from the existing KG rows. Safe to re-run: corroboration writes only when values change, embeddings only backfill when counts are stale, and the graph refresh only runs when the snapshot is missing or claim support changed.
